chapter: Germany, Buck's death and ideas about life
title: Why he never had children
summary: He says he was too busy for children and is glad in one way and sorry in another.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: How come you chose not to have children?

That ain't my choice. I was too busy, man. I was too busy. If there was any children the person that would be guilty didn't know they would be, so they didn't take no time out and I didn't take no time out so I just let it go. It just wasn't

my formula, I guess. But today I'm glad in one way and sorry in another, because I wisht I had had a brother instead of a friend I meet to take his word for it and don't know what side of the street he's on. Had to take a chance. Just like a nurse, looked like my sister's child. She come here to help me and he was worse than a stranger. But that's the way life goes, I guess. Your relatives are more harmful than strangers, some of them.
